GoKey has developed a unique two-tiered hybrid DAO model which enables its community to co-own and co-manage small-to-mid-sized real estate investment projects.
Criteria for ideal investment DAO legal structure:
 1. Allows liability protection for co-owners of real estate
 2. Minimizes US tax liability and reporting requirements for co-owners
 3. Allows co-investment by non-US citizens
 4. Maximizes personal privacy and minimizes KYC requirements
 5. Maximizes numbers of investors to keep investment minimums low
 6. Minimizes administration costs to enhance overall investment returns
 7. Enables co-owners to actively participate in investment management
 8. Enables each GoKey “subDAO” to have a unique legal entity structure
 9. Enables DAO members to create new investment subDAO entities
 10. Utilizes legal entity types recognized in all US states

In this milestone, the real-world DAO to own and operate property will be launched by offering membership interests to GoKey Community members so that they can own and operate the property collectively. We will also create the subDAOs first governance action.
For this milestone we will:
・Launch GoKey subDAO as a Cardano Native community real estate investment club.
・Implement governance and treasury management for the project in accordance with operating agreement.
ms.criteria:
For this milestone to be accepted we will provide evidence of the token that represents ownership in the DAO being minted and distributed to DAO Members. We will also provide a link to the governance action that the DAO carries out.
We will run a marketing campaign in order to make the Cardano Community aware of this opportunity via GoKey's and Clarity's social channels including a twitter space.
The governance and treasury will be launched leveraging the Clarity Platform which can be found here: https://www.clarity.vote/
